one_line: Email marketing and automation platform (Intuit) with a broad REST API for audiences, campaigns, automations, and reporting.
auth_notes: Simplest path is an API key from account settings (used as Basic-auth username, password 'x'); OAuth2 available for third-party apps. Both self-serve.
self_serve_notes: Free tier (up to ~500 contacts) lets you generate an API key and call endpoints immediately; paid plans unlock more. No approval needed.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: 200+ endpoints: audiences, contacts, campaigns, templates, automations/journeys, reports, batches, e-commerce, tags, segments, account exports
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for subscribe/unsubscribe, campaign events, abuse reports, and more

existing_mcp.note: No official Mailchimp MCP confirmed; community MCP servers exist.

evidence.note: Full API reference fetched (52KB) showing endpoint inventory; auth/self-serve from Mailchimp docs

agent_notes: One of the easiest: instant API key on a free account.
